name: my-crm
description: Provider-neutral CRM expertise; ad hoc dynamic workflows require live BOS contracts

interface.shortDescription: Use CRM directly; assess ad hoc workflows when BOS contracts are live.
interface.longDescription: Use the installed BOS product to discover current organization-defined CRM sources, entities, fields, operations, limits, errors, and exact deterministic HTTPS actions. My CRM can contribute provider-neutral CRM goals, constraints, evidence requirements, and client work to an ad hoc dynamic workflow when the required BOS authoring and runtime contracts are available; BOS owns composition and control. Preserve source records while applying provider-neutral CRM reasoning, freshness, recovery, and presentation.
defaultPrompt: Using My CRM's configured BOS scope, find CRM matches for external attendees from my last completed meeting; read only.
My CRM's configured BOS scope: preview unsent follow-up for last completed meeting external attendees; show recipients and text.
My CRM's configured BOS scope: find last completed meeting attendees' CRM matches; compare the first across sources; read only.
